summary: Writes a 16-bit token a2 into a buffered stream, returning the token on success, 0 when a2 is the 0xFFFF sentinel, or -1 on failure. Takes a fast in-memory path when the buffered byte count read through this+0x20 is non-zero and below the limit behind this+0x30, writing a2 through StreamBufferPointerAdjust. Otherwise, without a file handle at this+0x50 it fails fast; without the codec object at this+0x38 it falls back to ThreeStepStreamQuery against the file handle. The main path resets and expands the output buffer at this+0x44 (BufferTruncationShrink, BufferAppendWithMemset, BufferBoundaryMarkerCheckSet), invokes the virtual encode method at vtable slot +0x14 of the codec behind this+0x38, then reads back the consumed byte count with FileReadWrapperWithLock and returns a2 when the read-back matches.

local_names.v4: buffered byte count read through the pointer stored at this+0x20
local_names.v6: buffer object pointer read from this+0x44, target of the reset/expand calls
local_names.v7: buffer object pointer after expansion; v7[1] is the buffer base offset
local_names.v16: saved buffer base (v7[1]) used to size the encode call
local_names.v17: local holding the 16-bit token a2 passed to the virtual encode method
local_names.v15: output pointer written by the virtual encode method
local_names.v14: result offset returned by the virtual encode method
local_names.v12: byte count to read back = v14 - buffer base
local_names.v5: success flag for the read-back comparison

operations.description: When a2 truncated to 16 bits equals 0xFFFF (sentinel), return 0 without writing.
v4 = **(_DWORD**)(this+32): read the buffered byte count through the pointer chain stored at this+0x20.
Take the in-memory fast path when v4 is non-zero and v4 < v4 + 2 * **(_DWORD**)(this+48) (fits within the capacity limit behind this+0x30).
StreamBufferPointerAdjust(this) returns the current write position and the 16-bit a2 is written there.
Return a2 after the in-memory write.
Without a stream/file handle at this+0x50, return -1.
When the codec object at this+0x38 is absent, use the direct ThreeStepStreamQuery fallback path.
ThreeStepStreamQuery(a2, *(this+0x50)) queries the stream; return a2 unless it reports 0xFFFF, in which case return -1.
BufferTruncationShrink(v6, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF) resets the output buffer object stored at this+0x44.
BufferAppendWithMemset(buf, 8, 0) expands/initializes 8 bytes in the output buffer.
BufferBoundaryMarkerCheckSet(buf) validates/updates the buffer boundary marker before and after reading the saved buffer base v16 = v7[1] at buffer+0x4.
v16 = v7[1]: save the buffer base offset at buffer+0x4; v8[1] is re-read through a second boundary check.

Virtual encode/write method at vtable slot +0x14 of the codec object behind this+0x38, called with the token pointer &v17, the byte-pointer &v17+2, output pointer &v15, the buffer size, and the extension amount v16 + v7[2] when v16 is non-zero.
When the virtual call returns 1 and v15 still points at the local v17 (nothing consumed), return -1.
v12 = v14 - v11[1]: compute the byte count to read back from the stream (result offset minus the buffer base at buffer+0x4).
FileReadWrapperWithLock(v13[1], 1, v12, *(this+0x50)) reads exactly v12 bytes back from the stream file handle.
Return a2 when the read-back length matched v12; otherwise return -1.
When the virtual call returned 3 (v10 == 2 after the -1 adjustment), fall through to the ThreeStepStreamQuery result check.
ThreeStepStreamQuery(v17, *(this+0x50)) decides the final result: return a2 unless it reports 0xFFFF.
